summary.heading: Summary
summary.body: Front-end developer building production-ready Nuxt.js applications that load fast, rank well, and hold up under real traffic. Technical SEO is handled at the code level — not as an afterthought, but as a constraint from the first commit: structured data, Core Web Vitals, SSR-optimised rendering, and Google Search Console configuration delivered as standard.

jobs.context: Ongoing development and maintenance of martinique.airlocal.com, a Nuxt.js tourism platform serving the Martinique market.
highlights: Improved average LCP by 3.5 seconds across key pages
Brought Core Web Vitals to passing on all monitored URLs
Integrated new content models in Strapi CMS, reducing editorial friction
Optimised page rendering pipeline for consistent SSR performance
jobs.stack: Nuxt.js 3 · Vue.js · Strapi CMS · REST API · Technical SEO · Google Search Console
